sample_unit: Reddit self-stigma expressors (LPA); 8 clinical expert raters evaluated LLM responses
unlisted_practices: Persona-conditioned LLM responses tailored to latent self-stigma profiles of people who use drugs versus persona-neutral generic empathy
Sequential Bayesian and recurrent classifiers to infer user persona from limited posting histories
Decomposed rubrics separating holistic empathy judgments from clinically aligned behavioral targets when evaluating LLM support

screen.reason: The study tests persona-conditioned LLM response design against a standard persona-neutral baseline for supporting people who use drugs, evaluating clinical effectiveness and expert preferences.
